title: Deeper/broader DXF peer and ACadRust viewer-route refresh
scope: Screen an additional direct ASCII/Binary DXF implementation
Refresh CodeCAD's ACadRust dependency and 2D projection boundary
Check whether Kabeja adds a useful independent comparison route
Reconcile candidates with fast-slice cadence and 3D evidence gates

method.kind: Read public project repositories, manifests, lockfile, architecture, and README documentation
method.limitations: Evidence is from project-maintained repository metadata and documentation, not runtime validation. Mutable CodeCAD main was not identified by an exact commit hash, and the Cargo.lock bytes were not independently hashed; therefore the package pin applies only to the reviewed lockfile state. netDxf is archived and its declared feature matrix was not executed.

sources.revision: Repository and README reviewed 2026-10-18; archived repository page reports archival on 2023-10-11; exact commit hash not captured
sources.observed: The README declares MIT licensing; text and binary DXF read/write for AutoCAD 2000, 2004, 2007, 2010, 2013, and 2018; broad typed 2D entity support; AutoCAD TABLE import as INSERT; and inability to read REGION, SURFACE, and 3DSOLID due to proprietary undocumented data. This is a candidate 2D DXF comparator only, not DWG or 3D semantic evidence.

sources.revision: Mutable main README, manifest, lockfile, and architecture reviewed 2026-10-18; no source commit hash captured
sources.observed: README advertises DWG R13-R2018 viewing. The manifest permits acadrust = 0.3; the reviewed lockfile resolves package version 0.3.4 with crates.io checksum 2545729000aceb2c30e7002bdc26050532d5fa806bb6a6fef37175ebe6c8c5d2. Architecture documentation lists selected modelspace/block entity projection and maps supported shapes to 2D Kurbo paths, including spline/ellipse tessellation, LWPOLYLINE bulge conversion, and INSERT block flattening. Published entity percentages are project-reported, not independently reproduced. The codec lineage is ACadRust, so the application is not an independent DWG reader.

sources.revision: Mutable master README reviewed 2026-10-18; exact commit hash not captured
sources.observed: The README describes an Apache-licensed Java DXF parser/SVG converter, states that not all DXF entities are supported, and warns that text entities generate problems. No runtime or detailed source-route audit was performed; excluded as a stronger comparator because of its declared scope and projection-only output.

assessment.planImpact: Adds archived netDxf as a trigger-based ASCII/Binary DXF structural/field comparator limited to declared versions and supported families; corrects CodeCAD's pin terminology by distinguishing the semver manifest range from the reviewed lockfile resolution and records its 2D projection-only role. Kabeja is screened but not admitted. ACIS/AcDs and DWG support claims are unchanged.

implementationReadyChecks: Do not add netDxf as a dependency or routine test; select it only for a named unresolved 2D DXF question at an existing composed checkpoint.
Before an optional netDxf run, pin its exact source commit and runtime, then identify DXF version and text/binary mode; interpret output only within its documented entity scope.
Do not infer DWG, REGION/SURFACE/3DSOLID, ACIS/AcDs, or native CAD acceptance from netDxf's entity model or same-library round-trip.
Treat CodeCAD as ACadRust-lineage and projection-only; bind the app commit and lockfile hash and inventory per-type dispositions before any optional render check.
Keep tessellated/flattened display geometry distinct from exact NURBS, source graph/owner closure, 3D shape semantics, and writer acceptance.
Use only in-memory or locally-authored scratch controls and eligible existing samples; do not download or commit external/customer drawings.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.

workingTree.reason: The shared worktree contains extensive pre-existing tracked and untracked changes. This pass edited only the parity plan and its research receipt; all other state was preserved.
